arStrings.szText: {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}When you would be dealt fatal damage, instead you Heal to full Life, gain a Barrier for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2" * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, and Knock Back Close enemies. This power is disabled once used until you return to town.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
